meta.description: 复杂查询评测集，覆盖5个难度等级，用于评测 Agentic Multimodal Search 系统

levels.L1_simple: 简单描述 - 单模态、单一对象（baseline）
levels.L2_multi_attr: 多属性约束 - 多颜色/空间/数量约束
levels.L3_cross_modal: 跨模态 - 同时涉及图片和视频的查询
levels.L4_temporal: 时序/顺序 - 需要理解时间先后关系
levels.L5_multi_hop: 多跳推理 - 需推理多个关联事实

queries.query_en: stages of a flower from bud to full bloom

queries.query_en: images showing three phases of an airplane: takeoff, climb, and cruise

queries.query_cn: 一个人走进图书馆、找书、坐下来阅读的完整场景

queries.query_en: the entire process from rain starting to a rainbow appearing after rain stops

queries.query_cn: 先找到一张意大利面的图片，然后在其中找出含有番茄酱的那张，再找到该图片中是否有奶酪
queries.query_en: find pasta pictures, identify ones with tomato sauce, then check if the image also contains cheese

queries.query_cn: 找到有人在弹吉他的视频，如果这个人也同时在唱歌，找出视频中是否有其他乐器
queries.query_en: find a video of someone playing guitar; if they are also singing, check if other instruments are present

queries.query_cn: 找到包含宠物狗和宠物猫在同一画面中的图片，判断它们是否在互动玩耍
queries.query_en: find images containing both a pet dog and cat in the same frame, determine if they are playing together

queries.query_cn: 搜索包含自行车的图片，如果图片中有骑自行车的人，检查该人是否佩戴了头盔
queries.query_en: search for bicycle images; if a cyclist is present, check if they are wearing a helmet

queries.query_cn: 找到厨房场景的图片，如果画面中有炉灶，检查炉灶上是否有正在烹饪的锅，并描述锅里的食物
queries.query_en: find kitchen images; if a stove is present, check if there is a cooking pot on it and describe the food

queries.query_cn: 找到包含餐桌的图片，如果有食物在桌上，判断这是早餐、午餐还是晚餐
queries.query_en: find dining table images; if food is present, determine whether it's breakfast, lunch, or dinner

queries.query_cn: 搜索海滩场景，如果画面中有冲浪者，检查海浪的大小和天气状况
queries.query_en: search beach scenes; if surfers are present, check wave size and weather conditions

queries.query_cn: 找到办公室场景，如果有人在使用电脑，判断他们可能从事什么类型的工作
queries.query_en: find office scenes; if someone is using a computer, infer what type of work they might be doing

queries.query_cn: 搜索城市夜景图片，如果画面中有霓虹灯招牌，识别招牌上的文字并推断这是哪个国家的街道
queries.query_en: search city night scenes; if neon signs are visible, identify text on signs and infer which country's street this is

queries.query_cn: 找到运动场景，先识别是什么运动，再查找该运动中是否有球，如果有则描述球的颜色和位置
queries.query_en: find sports scenes, identify the sport, check if a ball is present, and describe its color and position

queries.query_cn: 搜索公园场景，如果有野餐布，检查上面摆放的食物种类，推断这是几人份的野餐
queries.query_en: search park scenes; if a picnic blanket is present, check what food is on it and infer how many people the picnic serves

queries.query_cn: 找到包含宠物的图片，识别宠物种类，如果宠物有佩戴项圈，描述项圈的颜色和样式
queries.query_en: find pet images, identify the pet type; if it wears a collar, describe the collar's color and style

queries.query_cn: 搜索市场/集市场景，识别出售的商品类型，判断这是室内市场还是户外集市
queries.query_en: search market/bazaar scenes, identify types of goods sold, determine if it's indoor or outdoor

queries.query_cn: 找到有人在阅读的图片，先判断他们在读什么（书/报纸/手机），再根据周围环境推断阅读场景
queries.query_en: find images of someone reading; identify what they are reading (book/newspaper/phone), then infer the reading context from surroundings

queries.query_cn: 搜索包含动物的图片，如果动物和人类同时出现，判断两者之间的关系（宠物/野生动物/动物园场景）
queries.query_en: search images with animals; if both animals and humans appear, determine their relationship (pet/wildlife/zoo)
